Herzogin.et: From Middle High German herzoginne, equivalent to Herzog + -in.

s: Seine k. und k. Hoheit der durchlauchtigſte Kronprinz Erzherzog Rudolph iſt geſtern, den 30. d. Mts., zwiſchen 7 und 8 Uhr früh in ſeinem Jagdſchloſſe in Meyerling bei Baden, am Herzſchlag plözlich verſchieden.

His K and K Highness, the most Serene Crown Prince Archduke Rudolph has suddenly deceased from a heart attack on the 30th this month, between 7 and 8 o'clock at his hunting lodge in Meyerling near Baden.
pacemaker (medical device implanted to regulate heart rhythm); colloquial usage includes implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICD) and cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT).
[…] dann hatte er so ein liebes, reines Gemüt und war so ein herziger kleiner Mensch, daß jedermann Freude an ihm haben mußte […]
[…] in the second place, he had so sweet a temper and ways so charming that he was a pleasure to every one […]
duchy (a country ruled by a duke)
Herzogtum.et: F>Inherited from Middle High German herzog(en)tuom. Equivalent to Herzog + -tum.

s: myocardial infarction (necrosis of heart muscle), heart attack

1851, Johann Wilhelm Wolf, Deutsche Hausmärchen, Dietrich'sche Buchhandlung, page 60
But it would have been all to heartless and cruel after all, if he had his own brothers been led to the gallows.
